messages:
jen: FYI SCIM consumer started returning 400/422s at ~08:47 UTC. Error in logs: 'unable to unwrap encrypted attribute' when handling group updates.

alex: opened alert. Any recent KMS changes?

riley: checking key rotations... I see an automated rotation for alias/scim-wrap-key at 02:00 UTC. The DB still has wrapped attributes under the old key.

maria: did the rewrap backfill run after rotation? I don't see success entries in the job logs, just a timeout: 
```
2026-03-21T02:05:12Z WARN scim-rewrap-job timeout: processed 0 rows
```

jen: that matches the provisioner failures. We should pause retries to avoid accidental deprovision events while we fix.

alex: pausing consumer retries now: `kubectl patch deployment scim-consumer -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"scim-consumer","env":[{"name":"SCIM_RETRIES","value":"0"}]}]}}}}'`

devops-bot: scim-consumer retries set to 0 (runbook:scim/kms-issue) :white_check_mark:

riley: threat check: no anomalous principals around rotation. CloudTrail shows infra-rotate service ran the rotation. We'll still audit the rotation details.

maria: mitigation options: 1) temporarily restore previous alias mapping; 2) run rewrap backfill to new key. Prefer #2 to avoid alias churn.

alex: agree. Plan: run a dry-run rewrap limited to 50 rows in staging, verify provisioning, then full backfill with rate limits.

jen: I'll also mute deprovision actions on the downstream reconciler until replay finishes.

maria: grep for leaked values in logs: `grep -E "scim-provisioner.*unwrap" | grep -v '\\*'` — nothing sensitive; extIds are masked.

riley: queued dry-run: `scim-rewrap --dry-run --limit 50 --env=staging`

devops-bot: dry-run job queued (id rw-789), ETA ~5m.

alex: dry-run succeeded; 50 rows rewrapped, staging provisioning OK.

maria: kicking off full rewrap with parallelism=3 and throttle. Notifying product/CSMs and scheduling a 12:30 postmortem.

security-oncall: action items: alex run full rewrap, jen hold down deprovisioners, riley audit rotation, maria confirm no logs leaked PII. We'll keep retries disabled until replay and verification.

jen: after rewrap completes, we'll run `scim-queue replay --since=08:30 --simulate=false --safeguard=check-only` to reapply suppressed updates.

alex: noted. Will post incident summary to #incidents when done. :thumbsup:
